references.text: Dibon is mentioned in connection with Israel's victory over the Amorites, where the city was laid waste.
Dibon is one of the cities that the tribes of Gad and Reuben asked to receive as an inheritance on the east side of the Jordan.
The children of Gad rebuilt Dibon, which explains the name Dibon-Gad in the travel route.
Iyim (Ije-Abarim) lies near Moab's border, and this verse refers to Israel's journey through this area.
The prophecy against Moab mentions Dibon as an important place in the Moab region.
Jeremiah's prophecy against Moab mentions Dibon and its coming destruction.
Dibon is mentioned again in the judgment against Moab as one of the cities to be struck.
